You just need a little more

If you’re like me, the Polyvagal Theory has become a big part of how you view your clients, your treatment planning, or your projects. But you might have a few problems:

  • How to implement your knowledge or even what state a client is in is unclear.
  • You’re busy. So, you don’t have the time or mental energy to learn more about the Polyvagal Theory deeply, even though you would love to.
  • And you want to make sure you’re learning from a reputable source. An expert who can make things understandable and can even help you with your cases.

Learn from a Polyvagal expert

I’ll clarify the pieces you’re missing and guide you on the next steps with clients or your projects.

I am one of a few hand-picked Polyvagal Institute Editorial Board members. I am globally recognized as a reputable source of Polyvagal information for providers and those seeking help. I live and breathe the Polyvagal Theory through my books, podcast, blog, and resources.

And I am immensely passionate about client work. I would love to help you through a 1:1 professional consultation.

Clarity & guidance

Clients, podcast audience, and professional colleagues consistently give me the same feedback - “You make things so clear!” I’ll do the same for you in our professional consultation work.

I’ll help you identify gaps in your knowledge, clarify misunderstandings, and conceptualize your cases or projects.

The other thing they tell me is, “Now I know what to do!”

You and I will get highly specific about your next steps, whether techniques with a client or refinements to your Polyvagal-informed projects.
